thread:
Lina: Heads-up: legal flagged the line in Security docs that said 'we are SOC2 compliant'. Can we reword to be safe and add a tiny export/pseudonymization example for ops? PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1422

Marco: Agreed. Suggested phrasing: 'Redwood maintains controls aligned with SOC 2 criteria and undergoes independent third-party assessment.' That avoids claiming certification outright without linking the attestation.

Tasha: For the example, engineers want a compact before/after audit-event and a small export command (jsonl) that supports an anonymize flag. Keep it non-prescriptive about key management.

Lina: Drafted minimal examples in the PR. Copying here. BEFORE:
```json
{
  "id": "evt_2026_1001",
  "user": { "id": "user_42", "email": "jane@corp.com" },
  "action": "api.token.issue",
  "time": "2026-10-01T07:30:00Z"
}
```
AFTER (anonymized):
```json
{
  "id": "evt_2026_1001",
  "user": { "id": "anon_7b3c", "email": "REDACTED" },
  "action": "api.token.issue",
  "time": "2026-10-01T07:30:00Z",
  "anonymized": true
}
```
Export CLI example (ops):
```bash
# request export with anonymization, JSONL output
redwood export-audit --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-09-30 --anonymize --format jsonl --out /tmp/audit.jsonl
```
cURL ingest hint (headers):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-RW-Audit-Retention: 90d" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"event_type":"api.token.issue","details":"..."}'
```

Sam: Add a short note on defaults: hosted API default retention is 90 days; Dedicated/Private are tenant-configurable and may be set by contract. Also call out hashing vs redaction tradeoffs: hashing enables correlation; redaction prevents re-identification.

Tasha: Legal review: use 'SOC 2' with a space and prefer 'aligned with SOC 2 criteria' wording. Also add: 'For attestation copies or export procedures, email support@redwood.com.' Don't publish the attestation link yet unless it's live.

Lina: Updated PR per feedback, removed any inline comments in JSON, used boolean for anonymized flag, added defaults and the support contact line.
